messages.subject: na.omit.geomorph.data.frame
parts:
Hello All,

I have a question regarding using na.omit.

I am using na.omit function to extract shape data from a data frame that includes more sample than I have represented in my phylogeny. But I am having trouble when I include more information in this new data frame. Here is my code:

classifiers.all  <- read.csv(file="classifiers_inGPAorder.csv", row.names = 1)
dim(classifiers.all)
[1] 62 11
nwt.tree <- read.tree("NWTfinal_renamedtoclassifiersGPAall.tre")
plot(nwt.tree)

SM.output<-parser(file.choose(), forceLPS = TRUE)
dim(SM.output$LM)
[1] 46 3 62

Y.gpa<-gpagen(SM.output$LM, verbose = TRUE)
gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(Y.gpa)
gdf$d <- Y.gpa$procD
gdf$group <- c(classifiers.all$Include)
gdf
ndf <- na.omit(gdf)
ndf

### It works well until here. Next I will include information only for the reduced dataset:

classifiers.red  <- read.csv(file="classifiers_inGPAorder_red.csv", row.names = 1)
dim(classifiers.red)
[1] 39 10
chk <- name.check(nwt.tree, classifiers.red)
chk
[1] "OK"
ndf.final <- geomorph.data.frame(ndf, species = classifiers.red$Species, genus = classifiers.red$Genus, elevation = classifiers.red$Elevation, temp = classifiers.red$Temp, precip = classifiers.red$Prec, lat = classifiers.red$Longitude, lon = classifiers.red$Latitude, phy = nwt.tree)

###Then when I run a procD.pgls, this is the error I am getting:

> model1 <- procD.pgls(coords ~ log(Csize), phy = phy, data = ndf.final, iter = 999) Error: Data names and covariance matrix names do not match.

I appreciate any help and suggestions to solve this error.

Thank you!
Julia

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] na.omit.geomorph.data.frame
parts:
Julia,

 

The error message you received implies that the names don’t match between one of your datasets and the phylogeny. Your code suggests that you checked the names of the classifiers, but not your landmarks. They must also have names that match the phylogeny.

 

Best,

 

Dean
